title: Frontier AI performance becomes accessible on consumer hardware within a year
method: Extract first consumer and frontier HTML tables; ignore repeated rendered tables; filter nonmissing GPQA-Diamond and MMLU-Pro scores, dated no later than article publication; keep record-high score per group and benchmark at each release date. No extrapolation or inferred missing scores.
limits: Historical article snapshot, not current October 2026 frontier
Consumer eligibility is the article hardware/quantization selection, not a fresh local run
Benchmark score does not establish equal latency, reliability or real-world usefulness
license_note: Epoch page CC BY attribution; preserve any third-party data-source conditions.
